entries.text: The quick switcher no longer shows a close button in the wrong place.
Run the cards on a LumifyHub board as a stack of tasks.
The message box shows markdown formatting as you type.
Enroll a machine with AgentOS Connect and receive its certificate.
Two processes can no longer both take over the same stale lock at once.
Machines can now enroll with a link code through AgentOS Connect.
Mark finished work as Done, and find it later in an Archived view.
Code review is required before a pull request is opened, and merges are blocked without it.
Cancelled checks no longer fail the merge gate.
Sessions on shelves now appear in one flat list.
Send now reaches the agent when you stop it, and old tool rows no longer stay open.
Sessions and tasks get descriptive names generated automatically.
Next-prompt suggestions no longer disappear when a worker goes stale.
The app loads with about half the JavaScript and stalls less during redraws and git work.
New sessions begin as drafts, and projects are simpler to set up.
Long conversations scroll smoothly, and older history loads as you go.
Status updates arrive as they happen instead of on a timer.
Terminals can be attached from more than one place at once.
Demo mode runs AgentOS on sample data with a stubbed chat.
A deleted session no longer crashes the server.
Demo data refreshes every ten minutes, and Done is refused on orchestrators and archived sessions.
A notice appears where terminals and new sessions would go, and asks explain the passkey.
Every session gets its own address you can open directly.
Projects can be configured for ports, agent environment and working copy setup.
Sessions on a linked machine can be opened through that machine's own AgentOS.
New opens in the workspace you have selected in the sidebar.
Each workspace's orchestrator stays pinned to the top of its list.
Check-ins for a missing session pause instead of failing.
Quoting a reply now includes its whole last line.
A failed start no longer leaves leftovers, and Done ignores files copied during setup.
Each session can get its own private database, set up in the project config.
A folder being removed is no longer reported as kept, and Done waits for cleanup to finish.
Orchestrator rows show their workspace name, and the header is more compact.
Sessions on a linked machine now appear in your session list here.
Messages from a linked machine show as event rows, not as your own messages.
The slash command list picks up new skills, and has a refresh button.
AI attribution is removed from commits, and pull requests that include it are refused.
Queued tasks appear in the session list, and each workspace can have a task limit.
AI attribution is now detected more reliably in commits and pull requests.
Workspaces with no orchestrator show a Start orchestrator row.
Projects can run sessions on linked machines.
The chat stays where you scrolled, and follows new messages only at the bottom.
Deploying AgentOS no longer breaks tasks that are running.
Choose how pull requests merge, and have branches cleaned up after merging.
AgentOS runs on Windows through WSL 2.
Merging, workspaces, devices, notifications and schedules are all on one Settings page.
Sessions pick up new tools after an update, once their current turn finishes.
Restart notes appear only for tool changes, and held merge requests keep their code review.
Opening a session puts the cursor in the message box.
Orchestrator rows show unseen replies, labelled Replied, Waiting or Idle.
Find text in a conversation with Command F, across its whole stored history.
The app stays responsive and stops rereading every session every second.
Long chats that sit idle are compacted before your next message.
Processes wait for a folder's removal to finish, and cleanup is reported accurately.
Add projects to a workspace more easily, and orchestrators can add projects themselves.
Choose which model handles each role, with a before and after comparison.
Agents routed to other models no longer compact every few turns.
Orchestrators now use Opus by default.
Work runs only through orchestrators, which send one digest per sweep.
Processes from ended sessions no longer keep running in the background.
Set one-off schedules and reminders for orchestrators.
Selected text can span messages and copies as a transcript.
Working context carries over when a long chat is compacted.
Stop ends the turn in progress, and you get an alert when a turn stalls.
The queued tasks list no longer goes out of date.
Long sessions no longer pile up tool output in memory.
Summary chips filter the orchestrator list, Done items fold away, and tasks show a tag for their orchestrator.
The orchestrator summary chip shows a steady highlight on hover and focus.
Code blocks and inline code in sent messages now display properly.
Usage is tracked in a ledger with daily totals, quality metrics and alerts.
Linked machines are reached through Cloudflare Tunnel instead of the relay.
A session that is compacting shows as compacting, not working.
The session row and header show which stage a task's pull request has reached.
Session rows no longer lose the PR stage and compacting status.
A session log is now written automatically when a task merges, without using any model.
Session logs are now saved and committed to your workspace's main repo automatically.
Merge commit IDs are no longer hidden, and merge times now come straight from GitHub.
Paired devices check in every minute and stop straight away once they are disabled or unlinked.
Orchestrators only hear about people who have messaged you in the last 24 hours.
Session lists and approvals load faster and send less data.
Chat attachments and restored activity load faster in long sessions.
Status updates only recalculate sessions that changed, so the app stays quicker.
Remote access now shuts down with AgentOS, and cross-site requests are refused however the app is set up.
Paired phones can now receive push notifications from AgentOS, and you can see each device's push status.
A first-run setup now walks you through adding agents, a first project and a first session.
You can send a blocking shell command or subagent to the background.
Tasks on iOS projects can now run and control their own iOS simulator.
Setup now runs health checks and includes a devices step.
Tasks now show a phone indicator and a strip of their screenshots.
Chat sessions and tasks can now run on the GitHub Copilot CLI.
The Settings test now also sends to paired phones and shows a result for each channel.
You can link and switch Connect right from the phone setup step.
Recipes save reusable recurring jobs, and plans can now be broken into pieces.
Task and session schedules now live in recipes.
Kiro CLI and the legacy Amazon Q CLI are now supported, with sign-in from your phone.
Done now holds only finished work, and tasks with open pull requests move to In review.
The sidebar fits on iPad, with no overlapping rows and larger tap targets.
New Ongoing and Snoozed shelves, plus Mark done and Reopen actions.
Selecting a session on iPad now puts the cursor straight in the message box.
Add a device now opens the app's QR scanner, and pairing links open straight in the app.
Devices paired through the native app can now approve requests by default.
Finished tasks no longer show as waiting for your input.
A new No approvals switch turns off every approval and agent permission prompt at once.
Assistant messages now have a Quote action.
An opt-in update banner, with a new Updates page in Settings.
Marking a quick change Done from the sidebar no longer gets stuck on Merging.
A new Experiments section in Settings, with usage tracked for each experiment.
Sessions now end with suggestions to save a recipe or keep a lesson, shown as learning cards.
Pieces go to the right repo and are never silently dropped or merged, and stuck work is cleaned up.
Merged tasks now appear on the Done shelf, so finished work is visible.
Merged quick changes now move off their orchestrator and onto the Done shelf.
Repositories that use git-crypt now work.
Orchestrators can now render and preview HTML pages.
Pieces that a parent's pull request already built are no longer restarted.
Usage windows are now measured from AgentOS's own agents.
Every share now includes a redacted Markdown copy, previewable and uploaded with the page.
Read-only subagents can now run on cheaper models.
Simulators started by a finished task are now shut down.
Your own sessions can now have a separate size for compacting mid-turn.
The row menu no longer shows a stray 0.
Links in your own messages are now clickable.
Finished sessions, including failed runs, now close out properly and leave the notification bell.
Background jobs show live output and clearly mark when they are quiet or have exited.
Messages, tool calls and turns can now be bookmarked.
Typing / anywhere in a message now opens the slash-command menu.
Sent messages appear immediately instead of waiting on a cold worker.
Dropped, done and archived sessions can be brought back.
Plans now show badges and a nested rail, and delegated work has a hover tooltip.
A new Artifacts view collects everything a session made in one place.
Background task items now end once their tool stops or their agent is gone.
Plan badges stay visible when you hover over a row.
The focus indicator is quieter and only shows the accent color when the view is split.
There is now one Inbox in the desktop header, and commands moved into the pane menu.
Restarts no longer relaunch simulators, and task briefs ask for targeted checks.
The session row menu fits in the window, scrolls when needed and is shorter.
Load is now attributed to the right session, and unmatched processes are reported.
Tasks now use smaller screenshots and can crop to a region, so they read less.
A single view picker now sits in the session header.
Pending cards now show on Needs you, in the sidebar and in the orchestrator.
Send status now says Compacting first while a message is compacted before it sends.
Status says Compacting as soon as a compact-first message is accepted.
Lessons now save correctly in projects whose instructions file is gitignored.
The Git toggle is hidden outside git repositories.
Retries carry on through an AgentOS restart.
Backgrounding a running step now sends your queued messages.
One status dot now shows machine load and health.
Typing @ in an orchestrator now searches your workspace and project repos.
Code blocks in sent messages no longer get stray blank lines around them.
Links now light up on hover, focus and touch.
Finished and abandoned task workspaces can now be cleaned up automatically by age.
Renaming a session keeps the cursor in the name field after the menu closes.
Ctrl+B sends the current task to the background.
Cmd+Up and Cmd+Down jump to the previous and next session.
Pressing Enter quotes the highlighted text while the Quote button is showing.
Download a chat as a PDF from the Download menu.
Agent sessions can now use the language versions and tools you have installed on your machine.
Finishing a task now removes the files it left behind on disk.
A Sign in button now appears for tool servers that need you to log in.
You can now attach PDFs, spreadsheets, documents and text files to a chat message.
The aos read command shows what another session in your workspace said and did.
Cmd+K searches the full text of all your conversations.
Ended tasks only offer Restore when they can actually be brought back.
You can choose an OpenCode model before sending the first prompt.
A session without a project now stays in the workspace it was started in.
WSL 2 and ARM Linux machines can now be linked and stay connected.
The stop command now reports correctly when the server takes more than one check to stop.
Connecting a machine now goes through Connect by default, and a flag keeps the older SSH route.
Sessions can be grouped inside a workspace, under Pinned.
Right-click the session list to create a new session group.
Tool calls that local models write as text now run, and turns that end early get flagged.
Mockups and screenshots saved by sessions now show up in the list, even after the task ends.
Export a session as Markdown, JSON or HTML, ready to paste into an AI.
Each agent role can now be given its own model.
An analyst chat can be paired with a coding chat that reviews each turn.
A side-by-side analyst pane shows review cards and can send findings to the coding agent.
Health reports are now written in plain English, with links to the evidence behind them.
Copy a single response or a whole turn as Markdown.
Creating a group from All workspaces now puts it in a workspace, and sessions can be dragged into groups.
Port checks now run per machine, and agents waiting on a taken port are told so.
Web updates are now refused when the server cannot restart itself.
Machines show their real names, and a machine switcher lets you move between them.
Verification results stay on screen after tool steps finish.
Dropped model requests are retried, stale edits are refused, and edits are checked for syntax.
Running steps now stream their output live in Pi and OpenCode.
The activity line now shows when the model is waiting, the current step and any retries.
The option once called Unlink and finish the analyst is now End analyst, with a plain description.
An update notice no longer shows once you already have the latest release.
Header status badges shrink to icons, and the filter row wraps instead of getting cut off.
Stalled model requests now stop, and a turn that ends with nothing says so and offers Retry.
An analyst can now run on any configured model that supports tool calls.
Finished step groups collapse to one summary line, and failed steps are named instead of marked with a tick.
aos spawn now opens a chat by default, and a terminal flag opens tmux instead.
Long names now show in full, and menu headers stay pinned while you scroll.
Every version of a page is now kept, and the pages view has the same actions as the card.
Follow-latest page links now re-upload automatically with each new version of a page.
Connect is free for one machine, and the same story now appears in the docs and app.
A deploy paused during an automatic restart is shown as waiting, not failed.
Sessions have readable links that keep working after a rename.
A page whose title changes in a new version stays one page, and the title follows the latest.
Two versions of a page can now be compared side by side or by their changes.
Share just part of a chat, choosing a range with presets or shift-click.
Search has tabs, ranks results by how much you use them, and > and @ prefixes narrow the results.
Hosts can now start live shares that guests join.
Passwords, keys and tokens that look like secrets are now masked in shared output.
Done chat sessions stay on the Done shelf, and the sessions tool lists them as done.
Each invite can be set to Watch or Suggest, and can include earlier messages.
Live guest shares now have a Drive mode on the machine.
Live shares can now require an access code, which you can generate and send to guests.
Copilot models now appear in the list, can be switched mid-chat, and respect your default model.
Agents sit on a rail, each with a searchable model list and a same-as-last-time choice, and it works on phones.
Status connections no longer pile up without limit when a client keeps opening them.
Internal tooling update.
Long sessions now compact their history at 150k tokens instead of later.
Streamed output is saved in batches every quarter second, which keeps long replies smoother.
Devices can now register for push notifications.
Agent sessions no longer receive server-only settings in their environment.
Older config settings are no longer ignored when the main AgentOS config is also present.
Sending messages without files no longer goes wrong.
OpenCode sessions can now produce a results summary.
The chat now marks the current model, starts with an empty search, and keeps focus on the list after arrow keys.
A What's New list in the sidebar shows what changed in each update.
What's New now sits as a small icon in the sidebar footer.
Large photos from your phone now attach to a chat instead of being refused.
GitHub Copilot chats can now ask you questions with clickable answer cards, like Claude chats do.
AgentOS now keeps itself up to date once nothing is working, and goes back to the previous version on its own if an update doesn't start cleanly.
A lightbulb in the sidebar shows one short tip a day about a feature you may have missed, and you can turn tips off in Settings.
Chats now fill the screen with earlier messages on open instead of showing a nearly empty view with a "Show earlier messages" button.
Tip of the Day now shows pictures and short clips that demonstrate each tip.
Chats now reopen where you left off, with back and forward buttons, a quick chat switcher and a keyboard shortcuts list.
Holding Shift with a letter no longer triggers the shortcut meant for that letter on its own.
Pressing Esc now takes you out of the message box when there is nothing else for it to do.
Tip of the Day images are larger on desktop, and you can tap one to see it full screen.
Update notices now appear as a small pop-up instead of a bar across the top of the app.
Run agent-os setup to get your phone connected in a few steps, and agent-os check tells you why a device can't reach your computer and how to fix it.
The session list loads much faster, especially on a phone.
Session list rows in the installed phone app no longer lose their short task prompt.
The reachability check now tells a stuck AgentOS apart from another program on its port, and setup keeps a copy of a startup file you edited before replacing it.
Chats now accept HAR network captures (with logins and cookies hidden), iPhone photos and many more file types.
